title: What `bach ... --json` prints
description: One JSON object on stdout, and nothing else there. `ok` is false after an error (the exit code is non-zero too) and then `error` and `causes` say why. Warnings are also printed on stderr. Fields not listed for a command are not there.

error.description: The first sentence of the error.

version.description: check, build, feed, inspect, version: the app's version (version: the one everything says, or the new one).

dry_run.description: version TARGET: whether --dry-run was given, so nothing was written.

changed.description: version TARGET: the files that were (or, with dry_run, would be) changed.

files.description: check, inspect: how many files are installed. version: the files that carry the version.

size.description: Bytes. check, inspect: what is installed; build: the setup file; feed: the setup file.

online_setup.description: build: the online installer, when there is one.

patch.description: build: the update patch, when --patch-from was given.

feed.description: build, feed: the update feed (latest.json), when one was written.

sha256.description: build: the setup file's SHA-256 (after signing); feed: the same, as written to the feed.

packed.description: build: the compressed size of the files, in bytes.

url.description: feed: the link the setup file is downloaded from.

signed.description: feed: whether the feed entry carries the publisher's signature.

ready.description: doctor: whether a build can go ahead.

problems.description: doctor: how many things to fix.

current.description: update: the version of this bach.

latest.description: update: the release looked at (the newest, or the version asked for).

update_available.description: update: whether that release is newer than this bach.

updated.description: update: whether bach was replaced. Not there with --check.

install.description: update: how this bach was installed; only a standalone copy replaces itself.

install_command.description: intune: the command that installs the setup file silently.

uninstall_command.description: intune: the command that removes the installed app silently.

run_as.description: intune: the install behavior to choose (a machine-wide app runs as the system account).

detection_key.description: intune: the registry key whose DisplayVersion says the app is installed (machine-wide apps only).

detection_script.description: intune: the detection script that was written.
